title: Numerical solution of the two-dimensional Calderón problem based on the Hilbert transform of a planar domain
summary: Let $(M,g)$ be a $C^{\infty}$ smooth compact connected Riemannian manifold with boundary $\partial M$. Consider the Dirichlet problem: $Δ_gu=0,\ u|_{\partial M}=f$ for $f\in C^{\infty}(\partial M)$. The Dirichlet-to-Neumann (DN) operator $Λ_g:C^\infty(\partial M)\longrightarrow C^\infty(\partial M)$ is defined by $Λ_gf=\left.\frac{\partial u}{\partialν}\right|_{\partial M}$, where $ν$ is the unit outer normal to the boundary and $u$ is the unique solution to the Dirichlet problem.
